adopt: Point it at a tax PDF and get every figure out as structured JSON, scanned forms included.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Your own tax data gets locked inside one vendor's encrypted format, and a filed return or a mailed W-2 is a PDF nobody's code can read -- half of them are scans with no text at all. Getting your own numbers back out means re-typing them or re-buying the app that sealed them.

Install
pip install awtax

Commands
  awtax

Quick start
  git clone https://github.com/Aitherium/awtax && cd awtax && pip install -e.
  awtax path/to/return.pdf # -> structured JSON on stdout

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awtax/
synopsis: Turn any tax PDF -- returns, W-2, 1099, statements, even scans -- into structured data you can check.
